subject.title: fix(agents): keep bundle LSP tool names provider-safe

question: Should bundled LSP tools globally repair unsafe or colliding historical names, accepting that policy entries referencing those names may require an update?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but whether previously emitted provider-tolerated names deserve an alias or migration is an upgrade-policy choice that source inspection cannot resolve.

options.title: Accept repaired names
options.body: Land the current behavior because unsafe or colliding identifiers are not a sustainable cross-provider contract, while preserving all already-valid complete names.

options.title: Add explicit migration guidance
options.body: Require documentation or diagnostics that identify renamed LSP tools so affected policy entries can be updated before landing.

options.title: Preserve legacy aliases
options.body: Add compatibility aliases for historical unsafe names, increasing runtime and policy complexity to retain permissive-provider behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept repaired names
recommendation.body: Land the current behavior because unsafe or colliding identifiers are not a sustainable cross-provider contract, while preserving all already-valid complete names.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline specifically routes the compatibility decision here, and the choice spans the embedded-agent tool contract rather than only the local allocator.
